policy: No testimonial, attributed outcome, customer identity, logo, or third-party endorsement is published without explicit permission for the exact public wording and attribution scope.

records.targetRelationship: MedPiper co-founder, senior leader, or board-level stakeholder with direct knowledge of Pranay's product and platform ownership
records.purpose: Confirm sustained product leadership, cross-functional ownership, and hands-on involvement without disclosing confidential operating detail
requestedClaims: Scope of product/platform ownership
Ability to connect operating workflow, product decisions, and implementation
One concrete example of judgment or follow-through
Whether they would work with Pranay again in a comparable mandate
records.notes: Do not ask for confidential revenue, customer, patient, insurer, security, or personnel details. Existing aggregate figures remain separately governed by the career evidence record.

records.targetRelationship: Engineering, operations, insurance, implementation, or customer-facing colleague who worked directly on the MedPiper workflow transformation
records.purpose: Corroborate how Pranay worked across teams and what changed operationally
requestedClaims: The workflow problem before the change
Pranay's specific role in mapping, product decisions, implementation, or rollout
A concrete change in handoffs, visibility, exceptions, or turnaround
A balanced limitation or trade-off that remained
records.notes: Use sanitized process language. Never request patient, customer, insurer, contract, security, or internal performance data that the source is not authorised to disclose.

records.targetRelationship: Former EY colleague or client-side stakeholder with direct knowledge of Pranay's SAP/process transformation delivery
records.purpose: Confirm enterprise process-mapping, solution, rollout, and stakeholder delivery capability
requestedClaims: Nature of the transformation problem
Pranay's role in requirements, blueprinting, testing, rollout, or adoption
A concrete delivery strength
A bounded outcome that can be stated without breaching client confidentiality
records.notes: Respect EY and client confidentiality, non-disclosure, logo, and attribution policies. An attributed statement is optional; a private reference may remain private and must not be implied publicly.

records.targetRelationship: A paying SignKit customer who has used the product on a real recurring workflow and is able to approve public wording
records.purpose: Provide independent commercial proof of the problem, product use, and practical value
requestedClaims: What they did before SignKit
Which parts of the product they actually use
A concrete time, privacy, quality, or workflow benefit
What remains imperfect or what kind of user it is not for
Permission to state paid-customer status if approved
records.notes: Do not request or retain their documents, signatures, identity data, or confidential workflow examples. A quote cannot imply certified e-signature, legal validity, or security certification.

records.targetRelationship: A future or existing client able to approve a named, redacted case study for a bounded workflow/system engagement
records.purpose: Demonstrate repeatable commercial delivery at the level implied by published engagement pricing
requestedClaims: Named organisation and approved public context
Original workflow and cost/risk of the problem
Exact agreed scope and Pranay's ownership
Direct product or system evidence
Measured or observable result
Customer-approved quote
Boundaries, exclusions, and remaining work
records.notes: A named case is not created from a sales proposal, unpaid exploratory call, internal concept, or unapproved customer work. Publication requires the full case gate in NAMED_COMMERCIAL_CASE_INTAKE.md.
